text:
maria: kicking off a piecemeal rollout for rwd-llama-v2q4-lite — goal is to validate quality and stability vs v2p1 (float). plan: 10% -> 25% traffic ramp in stages, shadow comparisons on the longdoc slice, and an automatic fallback if any gating rule is breached. quick thresholds I want feedback on: MRR delta >= -0.01 (relative), hallucination absolute increase <= 0.5% (slice-aware), latency P99 +20ms budget. fallback if sustained for 5m.

kevin: can you paste the gate config you intend to deploy? curious about windows and how many windows required to trigger auto-fallback. also: will KV warmup be enabled for the quantized variant?

maria: good Q — KV warmup enabled. config I'm planning to apply:
```yaml
route: rwd-llama-v2q4-lite
initial_percent: 10
max_percent: 25
gating:
  metrics:
    - name: mrr_delta
      comparator: lte
      threshold: -0.01
    - name: hallucination_abs_inc
      comparator: lte
      threshold: 0.005
    - name: latency.p99_ms_inc
      comparator: lte
      threshold: 20
  window_seconds: 60
  sustain_windows: 5
  auto_fallback: true
fallback_target: rwd-llama-v2p1
shadow_compare: true
shadow_sample_size: 5000
```

sasha: FYI longdoc slice historically has noisy hallucination signals (see 1717265432). for longform I recommend a separate slice threshold (stricter or looser?) — I'd advocate stricter gating for longdoc (0.2% absolute) or require confirmatory signal from two independent slices before rolling back. :thinking_face:

maria: noted. current plan runs short, convo, and longdoc slices in parallel but with slice-specific thresholds. summary of early shadow run (5k):
- mrr_delta: -0.008 (within bound)
- hallucination_abs_inc: +0.007 (longdoc spike) -> this breaches default 0.005
- latency.p99_ms_inc: +9ms
So hallucination is the immediate problem.

devon: thanks — that's actionable. my vote: don't tweak prompts mid-rollout. instead, reduce live traffic to 5% and let shadow runs continue while enabling immediate fallback on sustained hallucination breach. also watch GPU queueing: quantized model shows lower throughput and we sometimes see tail latency when cold KV cache. If GPU util >80% for 3m, trigger capacity-burst (or reduce qps).

kevin: alternative: temporarily relax longdoc hallucination threshold to 1.0% to avoid false positives from a noisy slice, but only if we also require the short/convo slice to confirm. otherwise auto-fallback is the safer path.

maria: agree with safe approach — enable soft-degrade path: traffic -> 5%, sustain_windows -> 3 (60s windows), auto_fallback -> immediate to v2p1 if 3/3 windows show breach on the longdoc slice OR if any two slices show breach. I don't want manual prompt surgery mid-rollout.

deploy-bot: config patch applied to route rwd-llama-v2q4-lite by maria — initial_percent: 10 -> 5, gating.window_seconds: 60, gating.sustain_windows: 3, fallback_target: rwd-llama-v2p1. (change-id: cfg-20260321-5) :white_check_mark:

devon: pinging infra to watch GPU util and queue length. I'll add a temporary alert: `gpu_util > 80% for 180s` -> slack alert + autoscaler hint. :loud_sound:

sasha: also pushed snapshot to the onboarding doc with snapshot id `sha:ae3f5c` and recorded the exact eval prompts we used for shadow. we should tag this in the rollout ticket for repro. :memo:

maria: thanks. I'll monitor metrics for the next 20m and escalate if rollback happens. if we end up rolling back, I'll do a short postmortem focused on slice noise vs model failure. :eyes:
